what: A 5-round differential characteristic of the Ascon permutation with 67 active S-boxes (profile 14-11-9-7-26). Rounds 1-3 and the round-4 input are copied unchanged from L. Sotomayor's 41-active 4-round characteristic (ascon-41-trail v1.0.0, trails/ascon_p4_41active_w125.json, MIT; copy in data/third_party). The round-4 output differs from the published one only in column 21 (00001 -> 11000 instead of 00001 -> 01001). Round 5's output uses S(0) xor S(a) in every active column. Words are x0..x4, 16 hex digits each; S-box index x0 = most significant bit; 'in' is the S-box-layer input difference and 'out' its output difference; round constants do not change differences.
